model.label: MXI
model.trainingSetting: Task-routed composition: 19 routes from 1011.ai self-trained pi0.5 checkpoints (single-task FM/RTC and 26-task FM), plus 7 unmodified official Bench2Dex pi0.5 checkpoint routes. Retrospectively selected per task.
model.evaluationSetting: One fixed selected checkpoint per task/embodiment across all four native channels; 50 episodes per channel. Original JAX backend for 7 official routes and PyTorch for 19 self-trained routes.
model.sourceLabel: Native evaluation logs; retrospective composite; not submitted or reviewed

protocol.expertReference: Per-episode expert_time_step from released Bench2Dex scenes, in native physics steps; never substituted with policy actions or policy queries.
protocol.protocolChanges: Retrospective task routing and policy backend changes are disclosed. All routes use model horizon 20; RTC routes execute 16 with prefix 4, other routes execute 20. Native reach-and-stop uses the per-task dwell: 3.0 s for Task67 and 0.5 s for the other 25 tasks. Recorded episode budgets, seeds and perturbation samples are unchanged. Run-policy entry-point injection enables PyTorch policies; see sourceComparability. The exact simulator checkout has not been independently attested for every historical worker.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / 50 per channel; equal four-channel task mean; equal task mean over 26 tasks.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean episode latched_stage_completion_rate, including all failures; equal four-channel task mean; equal task mean over 26 tasks.
aggregation.efficiency: Per task, mean expert_time_step / mean steps_to_stable_success over successful episodes pooled across all four channels. Overall is the equal mean over tasks with success, with valid-task count reported. This is not a mean of per-episode ratios.
aggregation.score: 0.45 * SR + 0.45 * LSCR + 10 * efficiency; SR and LSCR are percentages.
aggregation.missing: Efficiency is null with no-success status for evaluated tasks without successes; never replaced by zero.
aggregation.scope: Exactly all four channels and episode indices 1..50 per task; no duplicate reruns or selection of individual episode outcomes.

selectionDisclosure.selectionUnit: Whole task; same checkpoint across all four channels and all accepted episode indices
selectionDisclosure.criterion: Start from the recorded per-task self-trained highest-SR table. Replace a whole task with its unchanged official checkpoint only for higher SR, or for equal SR and a higher recomputed overall leaderboard Score with the stated 26-task/24-successful-task aggregation. This does not claim a global search over every possible candidate checkpoint.
selectionDisclosure.distinctCheckpointCounting: Official identity is weights repository + immutable revision + checkpoint-relative directory; self-trained identity is committed weight-file SHA-256. Five task routes share the same 26-task checkpoint.
selectionDisclosure.statement: MXI is a disclosed task-routed composition, not one uniformly trained checkpoint. Seven routes use unmodified official Bench2Dex weights and are not claimed as 1011.ai training. The scores are reconstructed from native episode logs, not spliced from published scoreboard cells. Eligibility and rank require maintainer review.

sourceComparability.run_policy_diff: Only main() -> run_evaluation(policy=None) injection entry, conditional use of externally supplied UEP policy, and delegating main(); no physics/control/metric/budget/success loop edits
sourceComparability.interpretation: Recorded official commit and protocol, current tracked-source diff, and representative file hash checks support comparability; they do not prove independent per-worker attestation of every historical checkout.
